selected_evidence.requirement: Only root and opsadmin may schedule cron jobs
selected_evidence.summary: The allowlist contains exactly root and opsadmin. Both successfully submitted test crontabs; antrieb was rejected before and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Retain the installed legacy OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic remained unchanged.

Healthy baseline boot ID a9593011-3617-4b72-8b02-2e8a4d2b17a3 was captured, reboot acknowledged, and new boot ID b4cd53ca-fbe0-4c1a-8529-8414e71e57c2 observed. Cron recovered active/enabled, the exact policy persisted, and post-reboot access tests passed.
